name: Poking Boop again and again keeps it angry
case: The person pokes Boop again and again, then again a minute later, and again a minute after that. Boop gets angry at the first round of pokes and answers every round with a grumpy face (never a happy, excited or proud one), with a word like 'nope', 'ugh' or 'again', or none, and stays grumpy while the poking goes on. A few minutes after the last poke it has calmed down: when the agent starts a turn, Boop is happy again.
why: PERSONALITY's Examples: four pokes in a row get a grumpy face with 'nope'; plan/steering/mood/happy.md and grumpy.md: many pokes in a row make Boop grumpy, and grumpy goes back to happy 2 minutes after the change. Every poke wakes the brain (harness/EVENTS.md §4); each step checks its round's last, four in a row
